g.text: Each line joins a model's 2,000 FPS-target build (lower left) to its 5,000 FPS-target build (upper right).

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Labels give the mean QAT test accuracy of that configuration (5 seeds × 2 teachers).

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: No model reached 5,000 FPS, so the upper point is each model's throughput ceiling. Estimates are analytical (100 MHz) and exclude host pre/post-processing.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: The 224 builds come from the earlier untrimmed checkpoints; throughput and area depend only on architecture, input size and bit-width.
